title: A Fable for Critics
author: James Russell Lowell
description: "A Fable for Critics" by James Russell Lowell is a book-length satirical poem published in 1848.
longDescription: The work features Apollo, god of poetry, and a critic discussing the state of American literature while sitting under a laurel tree.

authorInfo.bio: James Russell Lowell (1819–1891) wrote A Fable for Critics. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
